note: Credibility briefs on named 2026 presenters. 'flag' is a plain-language credibility warning; absence of a flag is not endorsement. Verified 2026-08-25 against primary sources.

speakers.name: Henk Rogers
speakers.what: Secured console rights to Tetris (dramatized in the 2023 Apple film); runs The Tetris Company; founded Blue Planet Foundation + Blue Planet Energy
speakers.note: Drove Hawaii's 100%-renewable law (2015). Most verifiably accomplished name on the roster.

speakers.name: Emily Fletcher
speakers.what: Founder of Ziva Meditation; author 'Stress Less, Accomplish More' (HarperOne 2019, bestseller); ex-Broadway
speakers.note: Taught at Google and Harvard Business School.
speakers.flag: Ziva is a repackaged Vedic/TM-style mantra practice sold at a premium; the 'manifesting' component is not evidence-based and performance claims run ahead of the research.

speakers.name: Murray Hidary
speakers.what: Co-founded EarthWeb/Dice (~$200M exit); composer behind MindTravel silent-disco piano in 100+ cities
speakers.note: Both the exit and the music career check out. Two slots in 2026.

speakers.name: Peter Crone
speakers.tier: well-known inside the wellness/podcast world only
speakers.what: 'The Mind Architect' - mindset coach to pro athletes; regular on Aubrey Marcus, Impact Theory, Commune
speakers.flag: Degrees are Loughborough sport/exercise science, not psychology or clinical practice. Not a licensed therapist; no peer-reviewed work behind 'redesigning the subconscious'. Reputation rests on client testimony. No scandal.

speakers.name: Eben Pagan
speakers.what: As 'David DeAngelo' wrote Double Your Dating (2001), built a ~$20M/yr info-product business; now sells business/marketing courses
speakers.flag: Origin is the pickup-artist industry; current business is the same high-ticket funnel aimed at entrepreneurs. Has NO domain credential for his 2026 topic 'AI, Art, and the Future'.

speakers.name: Robert Edward Grant
speakers.what: Ex-President of Allergan Medical, ex-CEO Bausch + Lomb Surgical; founder/CEO Crown Sterling; self-described polymath
speakers.flag: His 2019 Black Hat talk on 'quasi-prime numbers'/'Time AI' was denounced from the floor by Trail of Bits CEO Dan Guido ('should be ashamed'). Black Hat pulled the video; Crown Sterling sued. Cryptographer Jean-Philippe Aumasson: 'all the signs of snake-oil crypto'. Bruce Schneier filed it under 'The Doghouse'. Business career is real; the mathematical claims are rejected by mainstream cryptography.

speakers.name: Dr. Robert Love
speakers.what: TikTok Alzheimer's-prevention personality (~1M+ followers); sells supplements
speakers.flag: WEAKEST name on the roster. 'Neuroscientist' title widely disputed - background is psychology, not neuroscience, and he used 'Dr.' before holding a doctorate. Sustained criticism for supplement promotion. NOT the Linux kernel author of the same name.

speakers.name: Jackie Rotman
speakers.what: Founder/CEO Center for Intimacy Justice; her investigation into Meta rejecting women's-health ads ran in the NYT and changed Meta policy; Obama Foundation Leader
speakers.flag: Genuine credentials - but her 2026 slot is 'Telepathy Demonstration', outside anything she is credentialed for.

speakers.name: Aneel Paulus
speakers.what: Translational oncologist, adjunct assoc. professor at Mayo Clinic, 55+ peer-reviewed papers
speakers.flag: Entirely outside his field on 'How to Die Before You Die'.
